auth_files.title: Auth Files Management
auth_files.empty_desc: Upload an auth file or connect a provider with OAuth to get started.
auth_files.search_empty_desc: Try changing the filters or clearing the search box.
auth_files.cooldown_note: Local scheduling snapshot; remaining times are estimates. Expiry does not guarantee availability, quota recovery, or an automatic retry. Model names are internal state keys; backoff levels are not failure counts.
auth_files.cooldown_reset_hint: Clear this credential's local routing cooldown
auth_files.cooldown_reset_confirm: Clear the local routing cooldown for “{{name}}”? This may make the credential eligible for another request immediately. It does not restore upstream quota.
auth_files.cooldown_reason_payment_required: Access restricted (402/403; not a billing diagnosis)
auth_files.refresh_all_confirm: Refresh all eligible credentials on the server, not just the current filtered results. The backend skips disabled or ineligible credentials. This does not reload the list or reset quotas and may take several minutes. Continue?
auth_files.refresh_all_empty: No credentials were eligible for refresh.
auth_files.refresh_all_failed: Could not obtain complete refresh results: {{message}}. Some credentials may already have refreshed. Check the list before retrying.
auth_files.manual_refresh_failed: Failed to request credential refresh for "{{name}}": {{message}}
auth_files.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete file
auth_files.delete_all_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all auth files? This operation cannot be undone!
auth_files.delete_filtered_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all {{type}} auth files? This operation cannot be undone!
auth_files.delete_problem_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all problematic auth files? This operation cannot be undone!
auth_files.delete_problem_filtered_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all problematic {{type}} auth files? This operation cannot be undone!
auth_files.delete_filtered_result_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete auth files in the current filtered results? This operation cannot be undone!
auth_files.delete_filtered_partial: {{type}} auth files deletion finished: {{success}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed
auth_files.delete_filtered_none: No deletable auth files under the current filter ({{type}})
auth_files.delete_problem_partial: Problematic auth files deletion finished: {{success}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed
auth_files.delete_problem_filtered_partial: Problematic {{type}} auth files deletion finished: {{success}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed
auth_files.delete_problem_none: No deletable problematic auth files under the current filter
auth_files.delete_problem_filtered_none: No deletable problematic {{type}} auth files under the current filter
auth_files.delete_filtered_result_success: Deleted {{count}} auth files from the filtered results successfully
auth_files.delete_filtered_result_partial: Filtered result deletion finished: {{success}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed
auth_files.delete_filtered_result_none: No deletable auth files in the current filtered results
auth_files.search_label: Search credentials by name, account, type, provider, or error message
auth_files.search_placeholder: Search name, account, type, provider, or error (403, 429, invalid). Use * as a wildcard
auth_files.models_empty: No available models for this credential
auth_files.models_empty_desc: This credential may not be loaded by the server yet, or no models are bound to it.
auth_files.models_unsupported: This feature is not supported in the current version
auth_files.models_unsupported_desc: Please update CLI Proxy API to the latest version and try again
auth_files.batch_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} files?
auth_files.priority_hint: Integers only. Invalid values are ignored. Larger value means higher priority.
auth_files.weight_tooltip: Defaults to 1. Values at or below 0 exclude this credential from weighted scheduling; maximum 1,000,000. After entering a value, enable weighted round robin for it to take effect.
auth_files.weight_hint: Defaults to 1. Values at or below 0 exclude this credential from weighted scheduling; maximum 1,000,000.
auth_files.weight_strategy_note: Takes effect only with <settingsLink>weighted round robin</settingsLink> enabled.
auth_files.disable_cooling_hint: Skip failure cooldown and exponential backoff only for this credential; other credentials are unaffected.
auth_files.use_siwc_hint: Use the bound SIWC credential when enabled. Turning this off only disables SIWC and preserves binding data. Complete binding before enabling.
auth_files.websockets_hint: Enable Responses API websocket transport for this credential.
auth_files.using_api_hint: Use the official xAI API when enabled; use Grok CLI chat-proxy when disabled.
auth_files.policy_alias_fork: Keep the original model in listings
auth_files.policy_alias_force_mapping: Rewrite response model to the alias
auth_files.policy_unsupported: Existing data cannot be edited with this form and will be preserved. Select Inherit to clear it, or replace it to start a new list.
auth_files.policy_retry_hint: Inherit uses the global request-retry setting. Custom 0 explicitly disables request retries for this credential.
auth_files.policy_aliases_hint: Account aliases are checked first; unmatched aliases fall back to channel aliases. Inherit or an empty list clears only account aliases.
auth_files.policy_rules_hint: Custom rules take precedence in list order. Inherit or an empty list uses inherited rules; it does not disable them. Regex patterns use Go syntax.
auth_files.policy_retry_invalid: Enter a non-negative safe integer, or select Inherit.
auth_files.policy_aliases_invalid: Enter a non-empty model name and alias for each new or edited row.
auth_files.policy_rules_invalid: Complete each edited rule with a positive status, an action and at least one non-empty match condition.
auth_files.note_placeholder: Enter a note, e.g.: John's account
auth_files.headers_invalid_json: Custom headers must be valid JSON.
auth_files.headers_invalid_object: Custom headers must be a JSON object.
auth_files.headers_invalid_value: Each custom header value must be a string.
auth_files.prefix_proxy_invalid_json: This auth file is not a JSON object, so fields cannot be edited.
auth_files.prefix_proxy_html_challenge: Downloaded content is an HTML challenge page, not an auth JSON object. Re-authenticate or replace this auth file before editing fields.
auth_files.quota_refresh_hint: Refresh quota only for this credential

codex_quota.credit_overage_scope_note: Applies to all apps authorized to use this ChatGPT plan.
codex_quota.credit_overage_shared_note: {{total}} credentials in this panel share this account setting.
codex_quota.credit_overage_success_allowed: Credits after the usage limit are now allowed for "{{name}}"
codex_quota.credit_overage_success_blocked: Credits after the usage limit are now not allowed for "{{name}}"

codex_quota.credit_overage_busy: This account is already being updated. Wait a moment and try again.

routing.title: Routing
routing.empty_desc: Add an API key or OAuth credential under AI Providers or Auth Files first.
routing.model_placeholder: All models (type a model to preview its route)
routing.tier_state_standby: Standby, used when every tier above is unavailable
routing.tier_state_skipped_model: Does not offer this model; requests skip this tier
routing.tier_state_skipped: No available members; requests skip this tier
routing.tier_state_cooling: Cooling down or unavailable; requests skip this tier
routing.tier_state_unknown: Some members' models are unknown; this tier may serve
routing.connector: Falls to the next tier when the whole tier is unavailable
routing.drop_new_tier: Drop here to make a new tier
routing.exhausted_retry: Returns an error after {{count}} more retry rounds
routing.footnote: The preview ignores session affinity, live API-key cooldowns and WebSocket preference. API-key models are inferred from configuration; plugin-registered models show as unknown.
routing.locked_priority_conflict: Cannot place a tier here: locked credentials leave no available priority. Join an existing tier instead.
routing.locked: Runtime-only credential: no file to store a priority, so it cannot move
routing.drag_handle: Drag {{name}}, or use the up and down arrow keys to change its tier
routing.weight_hint: Only used by weighted round-robin. Empty counts as 1; 0 takes no share.
routing.weight_inactive: The current strategy is not weighted round-robin, so weights have no effect yet.
routing.strategy_round_robin_desc: Each credential in the tier takes requests in turn.
routing.strategy_weighted_round_robin_desc: Requests are split across the tier by weight.
routing.strategy_fill_first_desc: One credential takes everything until it is unavailable, then the next.
routing.affinity_desc: Requests of one session stick to one credential, failing over when it becomes unavailable.
routing.request_retry_desc: Extra rounds after every credential fails in the first round.
routing.max_retry_credentials_desc: Most credentials tried per round; 0 tries all.
routing.review_hint: OAuth credentials are written one by one; everything else goes to the configuration in one write.
routing.save_partial: Save stopped: writing {{name}} failed ({{message}}). Applied: {{applied}}; not attempted: {{skipped}}.
routing.save_conflict: The configuration changed after it was loaded, so its part was not written. The board was refreshed; arrange again and save.
routing.unsaved_message: Leaving this page loses the unsaved arrangement.
